entries.title: Apps and the in-tree template
entries.summary: Build a native Qt app with Lumen controls and QOR service interfaces.
prerequisites: Commercial Qt 6.12 kit and the documented CMake preset.
Use the existing in-tree modules; an installable public SDK is still a roadmap task.
entries.boundary: Opening source is read-only. Building or running the template is separate; service intents can change the session.

entries.title: Lumen and Kit
entries.summary: Use the shared controls, design tokens, accessibility behavior and golden-image tests.
prerequisites: Follow the Lumen roles, reduced-motion settings and keyboard/focus conventions.
Use the commercial Qt kit and the documented visual-test environment.
entries.boundary: Benchmark visual changes on the same machine. Golden tests and rendering require an explicitly selected test environment.

entries.title: System services, input and audio
entries.summary: Find service contracts and the qorctl command reference.
prerequisites: Read each service's contract before using its state or intents.
Tests require private endpoints, virtual controllers and silent audio.
entries.boundary: qorctl can change theme, Wi-Fi and notifications in a running session. Discovery does not invoke it or authorize device access.

entries.title: Prism and platform integration
entries.summary: Find the compositor, shell architecture and performance requirements.
prerequisites: Linux and the commercial Qt 6.12 kit for compositor builds.
Follow the original QOR heavy-job lock and memory checks; preserve the running Windows shell.
entries.boundary: Software, sanitizer, GPU and physical-device evidence are distinct. Do not launch a display or access devices through discovery.

entries.title: Q Pi and device images
entries.summary: Find native ARM64 qualification, guarded application builds and image procedures.
prerequisites: A supported native ARM64 builder, commercial Qt kit, measured RAM and physical scratch capacity.
Use the documented authorization and action-time checks for any device write.
entries.boundary: Metadata checks, software tests and image composition do not establish hardware acceptance. This tool neither connects to a Pi nor writes an image.

entries.title: QQ games and assets
entries.summary: Find Studio, Player, samples and the asset-library implementation.
prerequisites: Build through the documented QQ product procedure with the commercial Qt kit.
Use a trusted test project and preserve asset provenance and project-trust checks.
entries.boundary: Building, playing, importing assets and publishing are separate actions. External engines retain their own licensing and automation restrictions.

entries.title: QQ Studio tools for agents
entries.summary: Discover the local stdio MCP relay and the source of live Studio tool schemas.
prerequisites: Build qq-mcp through the QQ product procedure and open a trusted test project in Studio.
An MCP client initializes the local relay and requests tools/list before tools/call.
entries.boundary: The same-user pipe is not a sandbox. Scene changes, logic execution and frame capture require their existing trust gates and user authority. Provider keys remain in the platform keychain; QOR keys are never exposed.

entries.title: ARQADE apps and games
entries.summary: Find the native app, games and rules shared with the upstream server.
prerequisites: Use the product build procedure and virtual input/audio for tests.
Shared game rules and fixtures follow the upstream change procedure.
entries.boundary: The website and server remain upstream. Local play or rule fixtures are not live network, payout or release acceptance.

entries.title: QOR Media
entries.summary: Find the native media application and its product build procedure.
prerequisites: Use the commercial Qt kit and the documented product build.
Retain carried-code licensing notices and use hostile file fixtures for parser changes.
entries.boundary: Opening real user media is separate from isolated fixtures. Planned format support is tracked only in the roadmap.

entries.title: Assets, themes and Store packages
entries.summary: Find package formats, validation and provenance requirements.
prerequisites: Follow signed catalogue and package verification rules.
QOR OS 1.0 uses free items and test CGT on the devnet only.
entries.boundary: Do not read signing keys, re-sign fixtures, install packages or publish through discovery. An asset listing does not grant install, execution or signing authority.

entries.title: The pinned QOR core bridge
entries.summary: Find the current core pin and its four exposed version/amount commands.
prerequisites: Use core/CMakeLists.txt for the pin and the upstream procedure to change it.
The current bridge exposes core_version, token_info, parse_amount and format_sparks.
entries.boundary: Do not copy key-handling code here. DRC-369 and agent authorization are not exposed through this bridge; use exact integer amount strings.

entries.title: QOR Launcher
entries.summary: Find the active upstream Launcher and its Qt shell.
prerequisites: Read upstream AGENTS.md and its current documentation before changing the Launcher.
QOR OS integration requires supported upstream bridge capabilities and a reviewed pin update.
entries.boundary: These are source references, not an installed QOR OS service. No Launcher, account or network operation is started.

entries.title: DRC-369 assets
entries.summary: Find the active chain pallet and core asset client for upstream integration work.
prerequisites: Use the active upstream chain/core sources; the root upstream sdk directory is frozen.
Read-only bridge capabilities and their tests must precede QOR OS integration.
entries.boundary: No DRC RPC or signing capability is advertised here. Asset mutations require the upstream core and trusted approval; QOR OS 1.0 moves no money.

entries.title: Launcher agent authorization
entries.summary: Find upstream agent-link authorization checks and the example client.
prerequisites: Follow upstream controller approval, capability, expiry and signature checks.
A new QOR OS bridge interface needs upstream tests and a reviewed pin update.
entries.boundary: An assistant cannot grant itself authority or obtain a QOR key. Source discovery does not register an agent, sign a request or expose these operations through the existing bridge.
